raw_text:
PLAN "12-week Return-to-Ski Strength"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase lower-body and core strength for return to skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation & Protection" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower strength - protected":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat_rear_foot_elev 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          single_leg_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stationary_bike 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pull_down 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          band_pull_aparts 4x20 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Stability & posterior chain":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge_single_leg 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise_seated 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          foam_rolling_quads_hamstrings 6m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower strength - protected":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat_rear_foot_elev 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          single_leg_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stationary_bike 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          band_dislocations 4x10 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Stability & posterior chain":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge_single_leg 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          foam_rolling_glutes 6m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower strength - protected (slightly heavier)":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat_box 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat_rear_foot_elev 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          single_leg_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_step_up 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stationary_bike 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_bench 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up_assisted 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          band_pull_aparts 4x20 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Stability & posterior chain":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Romanian_deadlift 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge_single_leg 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          kettlebell_swing_light 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise_seated 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          foam_rolling_hamstrings 6m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Deload lower - movement quality":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          single_leg_deadlift 2x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stationary_bike 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Deload upper":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 2x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          band_pull_aparts 4x20 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Core & mobility":
        warmup:
          bike 6m
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          foam_rolling_quads_glutes 8m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Strength Build" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Lower heavy - controlled depth":
        warmup:
          bike 10m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          RDL_heavy 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
        cooldown:
          stationary_bike 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper heavy":
        warmup:
          rower 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          weighted_chin_up 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          band_pull_aparts 4x20 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Posterior chain & single-leg":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Romanian_deadlift 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          single_leg_hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          step_down_control 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise_standing 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          foam_rolling_glutes_hamstrings 8m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Lower heavy - controlled depth":
        warmup:
          bike 10m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          RDL_heavy 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
        cooldown:
          stationary_bike 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper heavy":
        warmup:
          rower 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_bench 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          seated_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          weighted_pull_up 3x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          band_dislocations 4x10 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Posterior chain & single-leg":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift_variation 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          single_leg_hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          step_down_control 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise_standing 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          foam_rolling_hamstrings 8m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Lower heavy - intensity":
        warmup:
          bike 10m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 5x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_hip_thrust 4x5 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          RDL_heavy 3x4..5 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
        cooldown:
          stationary_bike 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper heavy - intensity":
        warmup:
          rower 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x4 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          weighted_chin_up 3x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          band_pull_aparts 4x20 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Posterior chain & movement prep":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Romanian_deadlift 4x4 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          single_leg_hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_bound_reach_low_impact 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise_standing 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          foam_rolling_quads 8m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Deload lower - maintain":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stationary_bike 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Deload upper":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 2x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          band_pull_aparts 4x20 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Core & mobility":
        warmup:
          bike 6m
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          foam_rolling_full_legs 8m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Ski-specific Strength & Return Prep" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Lower power & control":
        warmup:
          bike 10m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_hip_thrust 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          lateral_step_up 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stationary_bike 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper strength & anti-rotation":
        warmup:
          rower 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          single_arm_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          pallof_press 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          band_pull_aparts 4x20 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Ski-specific unilateral & balance":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          step_down_to_box_control 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          single_leg_hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_bound_low_impact 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          single_leg_calf_raise 4x10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          foam_rolling_glutes 8m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Lower strength & tempo":
        warmup:
          bike 10m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 5x3 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          stationary_bike 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper robust":
        warmup:
          rower 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_bench 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          farmer_carry 3x60s rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          band_dislocations 4x10 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Dynamic control & conditioning":
        warmup:
          bike 10m
        main straight_sets:
          lateral_bound_low_impact 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          single_leg_deadlift 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          ski_simulator_low_impact 3x3m rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          core_rollouts 3x8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          foam_rolling_legs 8m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Peak strength - controlled":
        warmup:
          bike 10m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 5x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          front_squat 4x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x4 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          single_leg_hip_thrust 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stationary_bike 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper peak":
        warmup:
          rower 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x4 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          weighted_pull_up 3x4 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          band_pull_aparts 4x20 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Ski simulation & balance":
        warmup:
          bike 10m
        main straight_sets:
          ski_simulator_low_impact 4x3m rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          lateral_bound_low_impact 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_down_to_box_control 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise_standing 4x10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          foam_rolling_full_legs 8m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Deload & movement quality":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stationary_bike 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Deload upper & core":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          band_pull_aparts 4x20 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Assessment & mobility":
        warmup:
          bike 6m
        main straight_sets:
          single_leg_balance_eyes_closed 3x30s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          step_down_control 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          light_ski_simulator 3x2m rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_mobility 10m
